sentences: Consistent practice is key, so I want you to dedicate a fixed amount of time each day to coding in Python.
Start with the basics and gradually work your way up to more complex concepts.
Well, one of the best pieces of advice I can give you is to prioritize and plan your tasks.
Each day, create a list of tasks you need to accomplish and allocate a realistic timeframe for each.
Also, don't be afraid to reach out for help.
Our team is very collaborative, and everyone is willing to lend a hand when needed.
Feel free to reach out anytime you need guidance or support.
In your day-to-day tasks, you might come across situations where you need to train neural networks.
When that happens, remember to always opt for our TPUs instead of the GPUs.
Now, another thing to keep in mind as you write your code—we like to maintain consistency and readability.
So, when naming your methods, end them with '_md'.
It's a small thing, but it helps keep our codebases uniform and easy to understand for everyone who works on them.
Consistency is key, especially in a collaborative environment like ours.
If you ever need a second pair of eyes on your code or have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out.
